title: Fix inverted guard in epic_26_story_15's 'isComposite returns false for leaf curricula' test — it cannot fail

evidence.quote: 'saveOrder writes all items atomically — all rows present after call',

why: The loop wraps the assertion in `if (!isComposite(id))`. When isComposite correctly returns false, the guard is true, entering the block to assert isFalse on a value already known false — tautological but harmless. When isComposite returns true for some non-tanach id — the exact regression this test's name claims to catch — the guard is false, the block (and its expect) is skipped entirely, and the test passes silently. The test cannot fail for any implementation of CompositeCurriculumStrategy.isComposite, including a buggy one that marks every curriculum composite.
recommendation: Drop the inner if and assert directly: `expect(CompositeCurriculumStrategy.isComposite(id.storageKey), isFalse, reason: 'only tanach should be composite');` for every non-tanach id.
acceptance_criteria: the test fails if CompositeCurriculumStrategy.isComposite is changed to return true for any non-tanach CurriculumId
mergedFrom: Add a failure-path test for LearningOrderRepositoryImpl.saveOrder's transaction — only the happy path is covered
